name: Power Platform solution
short_description: A container in Power Platform that carries an app and all of its customizable components (such as apps, flows, tables and connectors) between environments. It holds metadata and configuration, not business data.

evidence.quote: In Power Platform, the thing that holds it together is called a solution.
A solution is a container. It's the box that carries your app along with every piece that app depends on
